skill.summary: 查询 OpenRouter 上所有免费模型并调用进行智能对话。支持 Gemma、Llama、MiniMax 等 27 个免费大模型，无需付费即可使用。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release.
- Query and list all 27+ free large language models available on OpenRouter (including Gemma, Llama, MiniMax, etc.).
- Chat with any free model via OpenRouter API—no payment required.
- Simple CLI commands for listing models and initiating conversations.
- Usage requires only configuration of a personal OpenRouter API Key.
